# Bennu Sample Inventory Reached 121.6 Grams

OSIRIS-REx returned material from Bennu to Earth on September 24, 2023. The mission required at least 60 grams.

That minimum had already been exceeded before the sampling head was completely opened. A final pour added another 51.2 grams, bringing the completed inventory to 121.6 grams—61.6 grams above the requirement.
